evidence: 11 Sentinel-2 chips at confirmed Ogallala substation coords (34.5197N, 102.0387W), 1-2 km buffer, spanning 2025-03-01 to 2026-06-15: all frames show pure West Texas agricultural landscape — center-pivot irrigation, crop fields. Substation structure visible and unchanged throughout.
Tight 1-km chip 2026-06-15 (imagery/s2_tight_2026-06-15.png): substation yard clearly visible in frame center; zero gravel pad, zero container rows, zero disturbed ground adjacent to substation.
Wide 2-km chip 2026-06-15 (imagery/key/s2_2026-06-15_xwide.png): 4 km x 4 km area around substation = crop fields only. No footprint at any quadrant.
Financial Security / NtP = No per ERCOT GIS June 2026 (14+ months post-IA signing 2025-04-21) — construction not yet authorized per the queue's own milestone tracking.

reasoning_evidence: Financial Security / NtP has not been posted as of the ERCOT GIS June 2026 snapshot (14+ months after IA signing 2025-04-21) — this means construction is not yet contractually authorized and no groundbreaking is imminent from known evidence.

COD has slipped 3 times totaling 28 months: 2025-12-01 → 2026-09-15 → 2027-09-14 → 2028-04-17. Every previously reported COD was missed, indicating a pattern of optimistic scheduling by a small developer.

Navitas Energy is a single-founder Austin developer with no announced project-level financing (only portfolio-level Leyline growth capital from 2022), no named EPC contractor, and no PPA announcement for Acker BESS — all prerequisites for NtP typically signed 6-12 months before construction starts.

Even assuming NtP is issued in Q4 2026 and a 12-18 month BESS build proceeds without delay, the earliest plausible COD would be Q4 2027 to Q2 2028 — roughly on reported schedule but with zero buffer. A more realistic scenario of financing / EPC secured in H1 2027 pushes build start to Q3 2027 and COD to 2028-Q4 to 2029-Q2.

Positive factors: IA is signed and FIS approved; Ogallala 345 kV substation exists and is operational; Navitas has a stated portfolio target of 500-1000 MW ERCOT storage with institutional capital backing. The project is real, just early-stage.
